meta.title: Live captions
meta.description: Captures system audio and the microphone, transcribes speech with a local SenseVoice model, translates each line into the language you choose and floats the subtitles over the window. Translation can run on the cloud default model, a built-in offline multilingual model (about 600 MB on first use), or your own Ollama/LM Studio server; "Offline mode" keeps recognition and translation entirely on this machine and disables meeting minutes. Open it from the "Live captions" pill at the bottom right; the first run also downloads about 240 MB of recognition models. Audio never leaves the machine — only subtitle text that needs cloud translation or minutes is sent to the model provider.
